scientific_limitations: The general cutoff is sufficient and is not asserted to be best possible.
The density is a relative density over prime bases and does not count arbitrary integers.
The basic abundant-existence theorem is due to Defant (2015); quantitative residue-class converse and density are the present distinctions.
Equivalent unpublished or unlocated earlier treatments remain possible.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Residue-class sign dichotomy for iterated Schemmel totients on prime powers
